I had a very enjoyable trip from KL, Malaysia to Jakarta Indonesia with Malaysia Airlines business class. It's possible to fly this short haul route in a long haul aircraft with full lie-flat seat, so I made sure to plan ahead and book the exact flight for that, since the price is the same regardless.

Jakarta's international airport was really quick and easy to get through this time. It's a huge change from the last time I landed there a few years ago when It was an absolute nightmare. I'm happy they've made such huge improvements in that time.

title: $80 Video Game Hotel Room in Jakarta, Indonesia 🇮🇩
